checks.name: state_transition_model
findings: all transitions have enough structure for preservation checks
checks.artifact:
S1: registered ledger contains pre-registered participants
S2: same-day ledger contains accepted same-day participants
S3: fee status is paid or unpaid
S4: materials are issued only after acceptance
T1: lookup participant in registered ledger
T2: collect fee for same-day participant
T3: write accepted same-day participant to same-day ledger
T4: issue materials and receipt
T5: reject participant when fee is unpaid
I1: preserved(A participant must receive materials only when registered or same-day accepted)
I2: preserved(A participant must receive a receipt only when the participation fee is paid)
I3: preserved(Rejected participants must not be written to the same-day ledger)
I4: preserved(Every accepted same-day participant must be written to the same-day ledger after fee collection)

genome.mutation: M1_TargetLanguagePolicy: set target_language to ABCL. Use OCaml ABCL/c+ as the default target. The meta file may still select any or another concrete target language explicitly.
M2_ZFirst: set z_schema to generated_from_initial_specification. Check the first specification by translating it to Z before program generation.
M3_TwoLogicalTransforms: set predicate_normal_form to checked_with_state_transition_model. Use two recommended logical transformations and compare their findings.
M4_ReviewThree: set final_formal_review to three_reviews_best_decision. Run three reviews again at the end and select the best logical decision.
M5_FinalProgramCheck: set generated_program to checked_against_z_specification. The final program is accepted only after checking against the logical Z specification.
